description: Updates fields of a location (PATCH with a required updateMask — only masked fields change). Pass the new values in `location`, e.g. {"title": "New name"} with updateMask "title". Set validateOnly to check the change without applying it. Note: every profile has a hard cap of 10 edits per minute (not raisable) — batch your changes into one call where possible. Returns the updated Location.

location.description: Location object with the new field values (only fields named in updateMask are applied).

locationId.description: Location id — bare "123", "locations/123" or "accounts/1/locations/123" all work.

updateMask.description: Comma-separated FieldMask of the fields to overwrite, e.g. "title,phoneNumbers.primaryPhone".

validateOnly.description: If true, validate the update without applying it.

name: update_location
title: Update a location
